data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English ‘Bealsige’, meaning ‘bright, fair’, Betsey is a diminutive of the name Elizabeth. Elizabeth itself means ‘God is my oath’ or ‘God ised with a pledge’ in Hebrew.
